description: This is a Flutter Dart source file defining a registration screen ('RegisterScreen') for a healthcare app. It manages user registration with email, password, optional full name, and role selection ('patient' or 'doctor'), utilizing form validation, state management, and navigation to different dashboards based on user role.

classes.name: RegisterScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the registration screen where new users can sign up for the healthcare app.

classes.name: ._RegisterScreenState
classes.description: The state class for RegisterScreen, managing form state, input controllers, validation, and navigation logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the text controllers when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _handleRegister
methods.description: Handles the registration process, including form validation, invoking registration API, and navigating to the appropriate dashboard based on user role.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the registration screen, including form fields and the submit button.
